limitations: The browser executes page.evaluate in the platform document; the full Module Federation package upload/load path is source-reviewed, not executed.
Development login uses the shared real HTTP authorization middleware; actual OIDC/Keycloak sessions and production behavior were not exercised.
App installations are synthetic SQL fixtures in the disposable database. The loopback app backend verifies HMAC and has a fixed resource-denial response, not a real business application ACL.
The cookie observation uses the real development session on HTTP loopback. It demonstrates lack of cookie port isolation, not a deployed console design.
PASS means expected observations matched, including the risky capabilities; it is not a security acceptance result.
